title: Trump Media sells another 2,628 BTC, holdings fall to 4,261 BTC
summary: Trump Media sells another 2,628 BTC, holdings fall to 4,261 BTC
briefing: Trump Media transferred another 2,628 Bitcoin to Crypto.com, bringing its reported sales over seven months to 7,281 BTC and leaving the company with 4,261 BTC in holdings.

title: Coldcard hack sparks biggest sub-1 BTC move since FTX: CryptoQuant
summary: Coldcard hack sparks biggest sub-1 BTC move since FTX: CryptoQuant
briefing: Bitcoin users moved 39,600 BTC in small transactions as the Coldcard hack continued, with researchers warning that the attack remained active.

title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
summary: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
briefing: A case tied to defunct crypto exchange FTX moves forward, a soldier seeks to dismiss over a Polymarket bet and a former congressman was ordered to pay $35,000 for manipulative trading.

title: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
summary: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
briefing: State officials reported that Minnesota residents, and largely senior citizens, had lost about $1 million from scams tied to crypto kiosks from 2023 to 2025.

title: Crypto PAC pours another $1M into Michigan House race
summary: Crypto PAC pours another $1M into Michigan House race
briefing: Michigan incumbent Shri Thanedar’s re-election bid against other Democratic candidates is getting more about crypto with an infusion of ads funded by an industry-aligned PAC.

title: Russia expands crypto mining ban to Moscow through 2032
summary: Russia expands crypto mining ban to Moscow through 2032
briefing: Russia has added Moscow, the Moscow Region and parts of Kursk Region to its cryptocurrency mining ban list, citing power supply concerns behind the restrictions.

title: Coldcard Bitcoin loss estimate rises to $70M after Galaxy analysis
summary: Coldcard Bitcoin loss estimate rises to $70M after Galaxy analysis
briefing: Galaxy Research identified 1,196 addresses that lost 1,082.65 Bitcoin in a 41-minute window, expanding the estimated scope of the Coldcard wallet incident.

title: Bitcoin ETFs end July in the green despite late-month selling
summary: Bitcoin ETFs end July in the green despite late-month selling
briefing: Spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $172.4 million in July inflows but remained $5.3 billion negative year to date after heavy withdrawals in May and June.

title: CZ Warns Bitcoin Holders After $70 Million Wallet Exploit: 'Nothing Is 100%'
summary: CZ Warns Bitcoin Holders After $70 Million Wallet Exploit: 'Nothing Is 100%'
briefing: The Binance founder urged holders to spread funds across multiple wallets as Galaxy Research put the toll from the Coldcard exploit at roughly $70 million—nearly double the initial estimate.

title: The More Americans Know About AI, the Less They Like It: Gallup
summary: The More Americans Know About AI, the Less They Like It: Gallup
briefing: Gallup says Americans are growing more skeptical of artificial intelligence, with rising concerns about job losses, businesses' use of the technology, and the technology’s growing impact.

title: Google Yanks Google Earth AI Image Tool a Day After Launch Over Deepfake Fears
summary: Google Yanks Google Earth AI Image Tool a Day After Launch Over Deepfake Fears
briefing: The Nano Banana tool let users generate fake satellite scenes from a text prompt, alarming investigators who rely on Google Earth to verify breaking news and atrocities.

title: AI Music Company Suno Loses Copyright Case in Germany
summary: AI Music Company Suno Loses Copyright Case in Germany
briefing: The decision requires AI companies to license copyrighted music used to train models and generate songs, marking another legal win for music rights holders in Europe.

title: US Is Banning Foreign Robots—Even Roombas
summary: US Is Banning Foreign Robots—Even Roombas
briefing: New restrictions block future models of foreign-made robots and connected power inverters from receiving FCC approval after U.S. national security agencies warned they could pose cybersecurity and supply chain risks.

title: Tether Reports $1.5B Q2 Profit as USDT Supply Grows, Gold Holdings Rise
summary: Tether Reports $1.5B Q2 Profit as USDT Supply Grows, Gold Holdings Rise
briefing: The latest attestation offers a snapshot of the assets backing the world's largest stablecoin, including U.S. Treasuries, repo agreements, and more than 146 metric tons of gold.

title: Circle Lands New York Trust Charter as Stablecoin Issuer Expands Regulatory Footprint
summary: Circle Lands New York Trust Charter as Stablecoin Issuer Expands Regulatory Footprint
briefing: The approval comes weeks after Circle won federal approval to establish a national trust bank, adding another license as the USDC issuer expands.

title: US Treasury Sanctions Iranian Firms Taking Bitcoin for Hormuz Passage
summary: US Treasury Sanctions Iranian Firms Taking Bitcoin for Hormuz Passage
briefing: OFAC sanctioned two Iranian firms including Hormuz Safe, which “accepts payment in Bitcoin and other digital assets.”
